content.rendered: “And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.” (Luke 8: 48)That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.In our Focal Scripture, Jesus gave an insight into the healing of the woman with the issue of blood. Jesus said, your faith has made you whole. Could it be that the woman may not have been healed except she had faith? Could it be that some people who were merely following Jesus did not receive miracles because their faith was not at work? Could it be that her faith caused her miracle to come faster? Could it be that her faith triggered Jesus?Friend, it’s high time you took your faith a notch higher. It’s high time you deepened your belief in God; it’s high time you held unto God more than you would hold on to man; it’s high time you began to believe God for the impossible and unimaginable; it’s high time you kept your eyes on Jesus; it’s high time you understood that Jesus has what it takes to turn around your negative situations; it’s high time you heightened your faith.That woman had suffered for twelve long years, but she didn’t give up on the possibility of her healing. She still believed God for healing, even when she had spent all and had nothing more to spend. No matter how long your challenge has persisted, and no matter how impossible it seems to come out of it, still believe God for your healing. Believe God for the impossible and the unbelievable; believe God for a miracle.What is that impossibility that you are currently faced with? Dare to believe God for solutions. Believe God for the specific solution you want to see; believe God for that particular result you wish to receive; believe God for that miracle, breakthrough, open door, destiny helpers, etc you want to receive in your life. Just as that woman believed and took action by faith, back up your own faith with action, and you shall have results.Remember, faith was the access key that opened the door of the miracle of the woman with the issue of blood.Rise in faith; step up in faith; take actions by faith, and your faith will pay off.Hebrews 11: 6 says: “But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.” Declare With Me: I walk by faith; my faith births results, in Jesus’ name!Follow on Instagram @jerry_ezeFollow on Twitter @jerrystreams
